projects.title: Transformer-Based Chess AI Model
projects.excerpt: Policy and value transformers plus alpha-beta and MCTS, trained on Kaggle T4 GPUs, with hard mode estimated at 2200-2400 Elo against Chess.com bots.

projects.title: Piano Music Generative Models
projects.excerpt: Controllable symbolic piano generation with a plain transformer, a simple VAE, and a hierarchical VAE, compared on reconstruction, attribute control, and listener preference.

projects.title: Exploration of Quantum Money
projects.excerpt: A survey of quantum money: the no-cloning theorem, Wiesner's private-key scheme and an attack on its verification, and Aaronson-Christiano hidden-subspace money as a route to public verifiability.

projects.title: Bayesian Hierarchical Item Response Theory for Mathematics Education
projects.excerpt: A hierarchical 3PL item response model with a skill taxonomy and response-time terms, fit in Stan with HMC and mean-field VI on NeurIPS 2020 Education Challenge data and compared by posterior predictive checks and approximate LOO.

projects.title: World Cup 2026 Predictor
projects.excerpt: A calibrated ensemble of LightGBM, an LSTM, and a Dixon-Coles Bayesian model that refreshes World Cup knockout forecasts each round, evaluated on 8,192 held-out matches and the 2026 knockout stage.
